_doc: Phase 3c audibles (play/audible.ts). options: the 2-3 plays the QB can check to at the line, per called play, from the same formation (trips has no run, so its run-like check is the bubble screen; the pistol has a single play, so it checks to the shotgun set with the same personnel). maxPerPlay: audibles allowed before one snap. cost: play-clock seconds the k-th audible costs = first + (k-1) x step (repeated switching gets dearer). The CPU defense re-reads after difficulty audibleReact s and picks the right counter with chance audibleRead (else it keeps its call); counters: the calls it checks to against a run / a pass. edge: a run audible against a blitz look that the defense has not adjusted to by the snap: the blitzers need blitzRunRead s longer to read the run (until then they only get an arm on the runner: tackle x blitzTackle), run blocks grade lineGrade better.
